scope: Verify the former cabinet print contact blocker and material-user UV repair on the current saved native source; qualify active measured main/decon floor graph. No full-room technical review, new /10 score, visual review or acceptance.
contact_method: Independently select all printed ink/oxide faces in 12 current evaluated joined stock meshes. Check every unique selected vertex, unique edge midpoint and polygon vertex-mean centroid against the actual case BVH using both closest-surface signed separation and declared front-face directional raycast. Also identify all 96 barcode cube islands and inspect print component metadata for coverage.

floor_node_selection_qualification: The first broad inventory selected a retained Brick Texture outside the measured tile-vector path, which has 1 m defaults. The separate active-surface traversal here selects the actual measured multiplier -> Brick Texture.002 graph and confirms the active 0.6 m width/row, Scale=1; this active traversal is authoritative for the floor scale qualification.
limits: No source or root script edit/save, rebuild, render, map edit, package extraction, promotion or merge was performed. Only fresh factory native opens and read-only probes ran.
No formal /10 score or full-room acceptance is assigned. Fresh complete review cycles 12 and 13, camera/render stability and independent formal critics remain separate work.
Vertex, edge midpoint and polygon centroid samples directly prove those sampled locations; they do not constitute a global self-intersection, arbitrary continuous-surface or runtime collision proof.
Stock print metadata was independently inspected for complete ink/oxide coverage without z filtering. Other registered components, including the battery labels, were outside this bounded recheck.
This preflight checks native procedural mapping and geometry, not Unity material equivalence or runtime performance.
